raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Enable MLAProlog for Kimi K3’s no-RoPE MLA on Ascend, supporting BF16 and MXFP8 projection weights with BF16 KV cache.

- The existing MLAProlog path assumes a rotary embedding, but Kimik3 does not need rope. 
- Use mlaprolog V4 kernel to support mlaprolog without rope.

## Modifications

- Integrate `sgl_kernel_npu.operators.attention.mlaprolog_v4` for MLA without RoPE, passing `None` for sine and cosine inputs.
- Route A5 MLA preprocessing through MLAProlog, reusing existing BF16 and MXFP8 weight preparation.
- Correct the `v_head_dim` argument passed to `NPUFusedMLAPreprocess` and consume the common Q/K outputs without assuming a fixed return-tuple length.
- Automatically select the existing split QKV/G path when ModelSlim metadata indicates different quantization precisions for Q and G, keeping construction, forward execution, and weight loading consistent.

## Accuracy Tests

```
CompletionSampler initialized with self.model='Kimi-K3' self.temperature=0.0 self.max_tokens=512 self.stop=['Question', 'Assistant:', '<|separator|>']
100%|████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████| 1314/1314 [20:44<00:00,  1.06it/s]
Total latency: 1244.369 s
Score: 0.944
Output throughput: 106.045 token/s
[METRIC] gsm8k_score=0.943683409436834 labels={"model": "Kimi-K3", "eval": "gsm8k"}
[METRIC] gsm8k_latency=1244.3688161401078 labels={"model": "Kimi-K3", "eval": "gsm8k"}
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

case: input: 16384, bs: 16
environment: 950PR TP16
model: KimiK3-w4a8

 mlaprolog kernel duration comparation between enable mlaprolog and disable mlaprolog in decode stage.
(based on profiling, weight:MXFP8W8A8 kv:BF16)
|   mlaprolog duration |  small ops duration | 
| --- | --- |
| 27.4μs | 61.3μs |

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+        mlaprolog = self.no_rope_mlaprolog or torch_npu.npu_mla_prolog_v3
+        q_nope, q_pe, dequant_scale_q_nope, qr, dequant_q_norm = mlaprolog(
+            **mla_prolog_input_args
         )

             dequant_q_norm = None
@@ -672,16 +682,24 @@ def forward_mlaprolog(self, positions, hidden_states, forward_batch):

         _is_dsa_mlaprolog = (
-            self.is_npu_arch35 or self.weight_quant_mode == 2
-        ) and get_token_to_kv_pool().index_head_dim is not None
-        return _is_dsa_mlaprolog or (
-            hasattr(self.quant_config, "ignore")

-            # Other ModelSlim projections retain the legacy MLAPO path.

-                hasattr(self.qkv_a_proj.quant_method, "quantization_config")

-                == "modelslim"
+            self.weight_quant_mode == 2
+            and get_token_to_kv_pool().index_head_dim is not None
+        )
+        return (
+            self.is_npu_arch35
+            or (self.no_rope_mlaprolog is not None and self.weight_quant_mode in (0, 2))
